source_row.rationale: New frequent watery diarrhea and cramping during clindamycin therapy require evaluation for C. difficile-associated diarrhea. The boxed warning notes that CDAD can be severe or fatal and can occur even after antibiotic exposure. Unsupervised antimotility treatment or simply continuing therapy without assessment can be unsafe.

source_row.stem: A client taking oral clindamycin calls the clinic because of new frequent watery diarrhea and abdominal cramping. Which response is most appropriate?
